description_sq:
Apartament 2+1+2 per shitje tek Medreseja!
Apartamenti ndodhet ne nje nga objektet e reja me moderne ne zonen e Medresese.
Objekti eshte ne faze ndertimi, me nje cilesi te larte projektimi dhe ka nje arkitekture mbreselenese me vetrata te medha xhami dhe orientim perfekt lindje, jug dhe perendim.
Apartamenti ka nje planimetri te rregullt dhe shperndarje ideale.
Objekti ka 2 kate parkim nentokesore, ku disponohen opsione me cmim esktra.
Zona ku ndodhet objekti eshte nder me te mirat qe ofron zona qendrore e qytetit te Tiranes, me sherbime dhe objekte te shumta arsimore, shendetesore etj.
Çmimi ne lek
description_en: Apartment 2+1+2 for sale in Madrasa! The apartment is located in one of the new and most modern facilities in the Madrasa area. The object is under construction, with a high design quality and has an impressive architecture with large glass windows and perfect east, south and west orientation. The apartment has a regular layout and ideal distribution. The facility has 2 floors of underground parking, where options are available at extra cost. The area where the facility is located is one of the best that the central area of ​​the city of Tirana has to offer, with numerous educational, health and other services and facilities.
